name: Allen Hurley
quote: This match was created to bring outstanding rimfire competitors together, remove the ordinary barriers, raise the level of competition and build an experience worthy of the shooters who earned an invitation.

rifleSetup.chassis: MDT ACC Elite Carbon Inlay Custom

interview.question: What was the vision behind the Subsonic Society Invitational at The Hideout?
interview.answer: We have worked hard to make the Invitational different — challenging stages, a meaningful cash purse, dedicated staff and spotters, hospitality, and an atmosphere where the competitors are the focus.
